gen-silkscreen-gf-zcool-xiaowei: ZCOOL XiaoWei reads modern and tidy, its strokes swelling gently from stem to serif without any ink pooling in the bends. And Silkscreen sits above it as a pure display face, every letter spaced out and drawn with no thick-thin shift at all.
gen-silkscreen-gf-zen-kaku-gothic-antiqu: Silkscreen spaces its letters so generously you can almost feel the gaps, like a lo-fi retro spaghetti line. Zen Kaku Gothic Antique carries the text with matching crossbar and stem on every t, and smooth curves that glide along.
gen-silkscreen-gf-zen-kaku-gothic-new: Approachable and low-key, Zen Kaku Gothic New keeps its open-mouthed curves clear, with no hairlines and no swells anywhere in the sans. Silkscreen is the lo-fi, retro showpiece; this one just reads.
